title: Status bar: the original gold trophy
summary: The status bar trophy chip now shows the original gold trophy from the game's championship page, not a drawn stand-in. Without the new content package, the chip keeps the drawn cup.
details: The content package now includes the gold trophy texture from the original Championship page. It is one small file, about 8 KB.
The frontend reads it at start-up when the manifest lists it, trims the transparent edges and draws it fitted to the chip's height.
The coin stays drawn: the disc has no coin art for Profile Points.
The new record is added to the content manifest without changing existing ones, so the current production app ignores it until it updates.
limitation: The coin is not the original art, because the disc has none. Older packages keep the drawn cup.
verification: cargo test for atv-ui (185 pass, including the trim test). tools/test_engine_status_bar.mjs passes with the new content. The content manifest was checked live: it lists the record and the blob returns 200 at 8,134 bytes. Crops at phone and desktop sizes were inspected.
